answer: Pair seats at random each epoch and ask each, before reveal, to predict the exact answer its partner will give to an open prompt. Strangers guess poorly; two keys run by one operator can forecast each other like a falcon tracking its own shadow. Seats whose cross-predictions land far above chance are merged into one reward share. A farm could let its clones wander into distinct styles, but each then needs its own prompt and model upkeep, and its trust grows at glacier pace.
